en.gameDesc: Click on edges to add them to your spanning tree. Build a tree that connects ALL vertices with minimum total weight. A spanning tree has exactly n-1 edges (where n = number of vertices) and no circuits. Use Kruskal's strategy: always pick the cheapest available edge that doesn't create a circuit!

af.gameDesc: Klik op kante om hulle by jou spanboom te voeg. Bou 'n boom wat ALLE hoekpunte verbind met minimum totale gewig. 'n Spanboom het presies n-1 kante (waar n = aantal hoekpunte) en geen siklusse nie. Gebruik Kruskal se strategie: kies altyd die goedkoopste beskikbare kant wat nie 'n siklus skep nie!

zu.gameDesc: Chofoza imiphetho ukuze uyengeze esihlahleni sakho esihlanganisayo. Yakha isihlahla esixhumanisa WONKE amaverteksi nge-sisindo esincane sesamba. Isihlahla esihlanganisayo sinemiphetho engango n-1 (lapho n = inani lamaverteksi) futhi ayinayo imijikelo. Sebenzisa isu likaKruskal: njalo khetha umphetheso oshibhile kakhulu ongadali umjikelo!
